build_srn_cars_dataset: build a tensorflow dataset from the srn_cars dataset using the SrnCars builder class
create_dataset_info: create dataset metadata with images, poses, and focal length features using the _info method
generate_train_test_splits: generate train and test splits by downloading and extracting the srn_cars dataset
load_scene_examples: load scene examples with RGB images, camera poses, and focal lengths from directory paths
apply_coordinate_transform: apply a coordinate transform matrix to align SRN poses with other NeRF models
